content: When drinking water, never forget the source of the spring.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Yin shui si yuan (饮水思源) — Classical Chengyu (Yu Xin)
explanation: When we attain success, comfort, and independence, human pride easily tricks us into believing we are entirely self-made. In truth, our cup was filled by the sacrifices of ancestors, teachers, mentors, and unseen hands. Honoring the source keeps the soul humble.
practicalInsight: Send a sincere note of thanks today to someone who supported or taught you before you achieved your current success.
reflectionPrompt: Who dug the wells from which you draw your daily comfort, knowledge, and security?
